Priya: Quick follow-up from today's All-Hands on pricing/usage. Couple concrete Qs: 1) Do promotional/free credits roll over? 2) Are rate limits per-project or per-org? 3) How should customers request higher quotas for launches? 4) Differences between Hosted vs Dedicated quotas?

Leah: Short answers — promo credits generally do NOT roll over unless explicitly stated on the grant. Paid subscription credits are accounted per-billing-period. Rate limits default at the org level but we expose per-route and per-API-key controls. Dedicated customers get higher baselines and contractable SLAs. We'll make a formal FAQ. :white_check_mark:

Nathan: Billing detail — promo credit expiration date is shown in the Console. We can make one-off extensions via support for edge cases, but not as a policy. For committed/enterprise deals, unused committed credits are handled per contract; reach out to billing@redwood.com for transfers or invoice credits.

Eamonn: Tech note — hosted rate-limits are enforced on tokens/min and requests/min. Typical response headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit: 600000`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 599000`, `X-RateLimit-Reset: 1746004800`. We also support route-level quotas and token caps per-key. Example internal policy snippet:
```
policy: {
  scope: "org",
  route: "/v1/generate",
  limit: 1200, // requests per minute
  burst: 300
}
```
Burst allows short spikes up to `burst`, sustained traffic uses `limit`.

Sarah: For customers — recommend opening a support ticket with expected QPS, burst window, and dates. For Dedicated we can pre-warm and reserve capacity; for Hosted we can provision routing/priority but plan ahead.

deploy-bot: Rate limit config updated in hosted-prod at 2025-07-22T14:12Z — default request limit bumped to 1500 rpm for trial orgs.

Priya: Thanks — two follow-ups: can Product/Sales get a one-pager summarizing default limits, trial limits, Dedicated entitlements, and escalation path? Also confirm whether sandbox/free-trial has separate per-key soft caps.

Leah: Yes — Product will publish a short matrix (defaults, trial, dedicated) + escalation contacts. Priya, please own the draft; review Monday. We'll also add a clear note on the Pricing page about promo credit expirations.

Priya: Got it. I'll draft the one-pager, ping CS/Sales, and link it back here. Thanks everyone! :pray:
